scientific_integrity: The infinite-family statements are proven algebraically. Independent algorithms supply finite cross-checks, not an independent external scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for binary exclusive-neighbor XOR on labelled KG(n,2), n>=5; no claims about majority rules, KG(n,k>2), or spatial orbit classes. Historical modular-rank results can imply portions of rank analysis; equivalence to any undocumented earlier dynamical treatment cannot be excluded. The flip-mask spectrum is for temporal two-cycles, not spatial graph-automorphism classes.
title: Four-residue orbit, basin, and flip-mask classification for parity dynamics on two-set Kneser graphs
